text:
Liam: Quick RFC follow-up: minimal control-plane <-> runtime handshake for hosted/dedicated/private?
Anya: Minimal set: identity assertion (opaque ref), capability manifest, telemetry sink hint. Keep secrets in control plane for hosted.
Sophia: For private, runtime must accept opaque KMS refs (e.g., kms://...) and never receive raw keys. Control plane does unwrap on demand.
Mike: Add lightweight probe endpoint for discovery: protocol_version, features[], max_seq_len, quant_profiles. Helps routing and fallbacks.
Liam: Proto sketch: {protocol_version: "1", identity: "opaque-ref", capabilities: ["streaming", "kv:v2"], telemetry_sink: "otel:http://collector:4318"}.
Anya: Tradeoff: richer manifests enable smarter routing but increase coupling. Suggest v1 minimal, v1-ext opt-in.
Sophia: Dedicated pools need tenant_affinity enum: shared | tenant-bound so router respects placement/eviction.
Mike: infra-bot: add conformance checks: probe < 2s, capability keys stable across restarts.
infra-bot: conformance-check queued for adapters (run id: 202).
Liam: Action items: Liam drafts RFC patch; Mike adds adapter-harness tests; Anya/Sophia detail KMS flows + failure modes.
Anya: Define failure semantics when manifest fields missing: fallback to conservative defaults + emit audit event.
Sophia: Also add exponential backoff for control-plane probe retries.
Mike: I'll create test matrix (hosted/dedicated/private x auth-mode x telemetry).
Liam: I'll open RFC PR today. Ping with objections. :thumbsup:
